content.comment_body: Hello experts, I have a [product_name] module ([article_no], 8DI/ADO). I read in the catalogue that 4DI can be operated in analog mode (0 to 10V). My question is: Can I use this analog input for 0 to 20mA signals? Best regards.
This is only possible if you use signal converters; the onboard analog inputs are restricted to 0-10V. Best regards,

The analog inputs on the base model are 0-10V. There is an alternative method to enable reading of 0/4-20mA signals. You can review the information provided in these resources: [url] Additionally, look here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking confirmation about the analog input capability of a [product_name] module, specifically asking whether it can process 0-20mA signals. Replies clarify that the onboard analog inputs are restricted to 0-10V, and current signals require signal converters or external solutions referenced by other users. The key UX insight is that the device does not directly support alternative analog signal types, which can lead to user uncertainty based on catalogue descriptions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the module’s analog inputs will natively support both voltage (0-10V) and current (0-20mA) signals, or would offer a simple way to utilize current inputs without additional equipment.
pain_keywords: lack of direct current input support
